author: Brandjuh
name: CuffIdWatch
short: Ping and/or DM members when their raw user ID is used.
description: A real @mention already notifies you; a pasted raw ID, ban list or another bot's modlog embed does not. Members opt in to an in-channel ping and/or a DM whenever their user ID appears.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-user notification preferences (ping on/off, DM on/off). No message content is stored.
